items.heading: Bustrengo
details: Key ingredients: bread, apple, raisins, cornmeal
Soak stale bread in milk until softened.
Mix in cornmeal, grated apple and raisins.
Pour the batter into a greased baking dish.
Bake until firm and golden on top.

items.heading: Fagioli con le Cotiche
details: Key ingredients: beans, pork rind, tomato
Simmer beans with pork rind until both are tender.
Add tomato and seasoning, cooking into a thick stew.
Continue simmering until the pork rind is soft and gelatinous.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
